result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel has clear layout defects: cards are not vertically aligned with each other, image heights and badge positions differ per card, and the first card's image renders on a pale placeholder-like background instead of the dark food photo used by its siblings. There are also minor styling inconsistencies in the favorite (heart) buttons and duplicated delivery-fee info.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the cards are not aligned on a common baseline: the Green Bowl Poké image starts higher and is shorter, Smash Bros Burgers is pushed down, and titles/delivery fees sit at three different vertical positions.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel items a fixed image aspect ratio/height and align items to the top of the row so titles and metadata line up consistently.

issues.description: The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail renders on a light grey/washed-out background while the neighbouring cards use dark full-bleed food photography, making it look like a broken or placeholder image.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment (same background/overlay and cover-fit cropping) for all carousel thumbnails, and verify the asset loads correctly.

issues.description: The ETA badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') are placed at different vertical offsets within each card image and one badge overlaps the very bottom edge of its image.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the ETA badge with a fixed inset from the bottom-left corner of the image container for every card.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a plain white outline heart with no background, while the card below uses a dark circular button.
issues.suggestion: Use one heart button component with the same background chip, size and icon weight across all cards.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows '€0 delivery' both as an image badge and again in the metadata row, duplicating the same information.
issues.suggestion: Suppress the metadata delivery-fee entry when the same promo is already shown as an image badge.
